title: add a tip-jar with, hear me out, flamethrowers

messages.content: ok listen zapp needs tipping feature, right? but here's the kicker: flamethrowers involved!!!

That's an intriguing idea! Integrating a tipping feature with flamethrowers could present logistical challenges. Are you thinking of virtual flamethrowers as a fun emoji when someone tips, or are we talking about something in the real world?
real world, obviously! who doesn't want a flamethrower with their tip? think about the merch potential!!!! tusla cars with built-in flamethrower tip jar!!

Combining flamethrowers with tipping might attract attention, but safety and regulatory hurdles would be significant. We'll need to ensure any physical tie-in adheres to strict safety standards. Perhaps a limited-run, novelty flamethrower collector's item from The Dull Company could work?
collector's item? nah, mass market!!! every tusla gets a flamethrower for the dashboard, can be a cigarette lighter too! it's genius, cfo's gonna love it!

While the concept of mass-market flamethrowers sounds attention-grabbing, Gary Puddle may have concerns about budget and liability. We'd need a robust business plan and compliance strategy. Perhaps focusing initially on a smaller scale, like limited-edition models for enthusiasts, would be a safer starting point?
